incident_record.enforcement_gap: The PreToolUse hook (write-contract-check.mjs) matches only the ORCHESTRATOR's Write|Edit calls, and the packet validator checks only the single declared artifact_path. Neither can see or restrain a delegated agent's own shell. Under this policy the write contract is advisory, not enforced.

incident_record.outcome: 6 subsequent dispatches, zero violations. Instruction-level hardening is NOT sufficient assurance -- it is probabilistic and subject to drift. Deterministic fixes in priority order: worktree/container isolation, command allowlisting, commit-before-run snapshotting, post-dispatch inventory diffing.
